facebook.content:
Family—We declare that every home under God’s hand will be a stronghold of love, truth, and peace. Father, empower each spouse to lead with grace, each child to walk in obedience, and every heart to reflect Christ’s character. Break every pattern of division and bind us together with your unshakable covenant.

Drop a 🙏 if you stand with this, or share your own request below.
